overview_description.description: CoreWeave offers GPU-based compute resources, storage, and networking capabilities optimized for training and deploying machine learning models. Its platform includes Kubernetes-based environments, managed software services, and tools for monitoring system performance and cluster health. It enables organizations to run large-scale AI workloads through dedicated infrastructure and configurable deployment options. The company supports developers and enterprises by providing scalable resources aligned with the requirements of data-intensive and compute-intensive applications.

about_short_description.short_description: CoreWeave provides cloud infrastructure services designed to support artificial intelligence and high-performance computing workloads.

product.name: CoreWeave Cloud Platform
product.description: An AI-focused cloud infrastructure platform combining compute, storage, networking, managed software, observability, security, and operational tools for large-scale AI workloads.

product.name: GPU Compute
product.description: Cloud GPU compute for AI training, fine-tuning, inference, and other accelerated workloads, available through a Kubernetes-native environment and bare-metal deployments.

product.name: AI Model Training
product.description: Infrastructure and services for distributed training of large AI models using high-performance GPU clusters, fast storage, low-latency networking, and operational support.

product.name: AI Inference
product.description: Infrastructure and software for serving AI models with low latency and scalable throughput across dedicated or flexible GPU deployments.

product.name: Storage Services
product.description: AI-oriented object, distributed file, dedicated VAST, and local storage services for training datasets, model checkpoints, pipelines, and inference workloads.

product.name: Networking Services
product.description: High-performance networking for connecting GPU clusters, storage, data centers, and external environments with low latency and high bandwidth.
